terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: Orthographic-style front/side/back sheet; browser review uses a 32 degree perspective camera and matched framing.

objectClass.notes: Observed across admitted GPT Image 2 front, side, back and three-quarter views. Archived v1 transforms and bounds remain authoritative.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Compound articulated assembly with radial repetition and mixed transparency.

detailInventory.note: Each visible identity feature and runtime effect maps to existing named procedural geometry or the v2 outline contract.

details.description: giant bubble and eight burst fragments

definitionOfDone: Four static views retain the v1 package envelope while reading as a more exaggerated faceted SAKURA game prop.
The front chamber keeps exactly eight independently named rings and spokes on the frozen rotating pivot and output socket.
The asymmetric reservoir, rear fan, control, feet and power inlet remain attached at archived parent paths and transforms.
Main, structure and detail outlines use 0.0048, 0.0041 and 0.0033 thickness with stable 0.18 object-space variation.
All 48 ordinary bubbles, giant bubble, burst fragments and reset behavior remain owned by the existing performance timeline.

componentTree.name: Bubble Machine Root
componentTree.topologyRationale: Runtime container for the complete appliance hierarchy.

componentTree.name: Housing Shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rounded rigid molded enclosure with a constant broad footprint and visible panel seam.

componentTree.name: Front Work Assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Discrete circular front assembly proud of the housing.

componentTree.name: Liquid Reservoir
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent rounded rectangular translucent tank attached to the right-rear housing.

componentTree.name: Rear Fan Assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Discrete circular rear ventilation and fan assembly inset into the back panel.

componentTree.name: Front Window Rim
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thick rigid circular trim ring with a rounded cross section.

componentTree.name: Smoked Front Window
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin transparent cover follows the circular working cavity.

componentTree.name: Bubble Wheel
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rigid radial wheel rotates as one assembly around the front axis.

componentTree.name: Wheel Hub
componentTree.topologyRationale: Concentric rigid hub cap on the wheel axis.

componentTree.name: Front Drip Tray
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent rounded catch tray overlaps the lower front rim.

componentTree.name: Top Control Knob
componentTree.topologyRationale: Separate low rounded control on the top surface.

componentTree.name: Reservoir Fill Cap
componentTree.topologyRationale: Separate round cap above the translucent reservoir.

componentTree.name: Rear Fan Rotor
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent rotor turns around the rear-facing axis.

componentTree.name: Rear Fan Grille
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rigid circular grille is physically layered in front of the rotor.

componentTree.name: Four Foot Array
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four discrete molded feet repeat at the housing corners.

componentTree.name: Rear Power Inlet
componentTree.topologyRationale: Inferred shallow recessed electrical inlet on the rear-lower housing.

componentTree.name: Side Vent Array
componentTree.topologyRationale: Seven repeated recessed rounded slots interrupt the side panel surface.

componentTree.name: Lower Panel Seam
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin raised/recessed mold split line around the lower housing.

componentTree.name: Bubble Ring Array
componentTree.topologyRationale: Exactly eight separately named toroidal ring modules repeat radially.

componentTree.name: Bubble Wheel Spokes
componentTree.topologyRationale: Eight short rigid bars connect hub to ring roots.

componentTree.name: Rear Fan Blade Array
componentTree.topologyRationale: Five low-cost curved blade solids repeat around the rear rotor.

componentTree.name: Concentric Grille Bands
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four concentric interrupted rings and spokes form visible grille geometry.

componentTree.name: Rear Fastener Array
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four small round screw heads repeat at the rear panel corners.

componentTree.name: Control Index Mark
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small raised/dark index line rides on the control cap.

componentTree.name: Reservoir Bracket
componentTree.topologyRationale: Inferred shallow overlap bracket connects the observed tank to the housing.

componentTree.name: Bubble Effect Array
componentTree.topologyRationale: Repeated low-segment transparent spheres are runtime effect geometry emitted from the front wheel.

lodPlan.strategy: hide powered bubbles when inactive and reuse geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Reuse repeated ring, spoke, vent, grille, bubble and fastener geometry; no runtime image textures.

proceduralStrategy: Build independent front, tank and rear assemblies.
Share ring/spoke/vent/fastener geometry while retaining names.
Use project ApplianceModelKit toon materials and outlines.
Pool eighteen transparent bubbles and animate without allocations.
risks: A deeper-looking front rim must not exceed the archived depth envelope.
Heavy outlines must not cluster on transparent volumes or small grille pieces.
The output socket must remain independent of the rotating wheel pivot.
